name: Ironwaft
description: Jabs the folded tip out from behind a half-opened leaf so the thrust arrives without warning.

name: Aegis Foldedge
description: Holds the ribbed guard edge toward the enemy and gives ground one pace at a time.

name: Fanoutjaunt
description: Slides the lead foot forward along the line of the fan so the closing step makes no sound.

name: Rimribbarrage
description: Flicks the sharpened rib across the wrist as the opponent begins to raise a weapon.

name: Silencing Fanspine
description: Spins the open leaf over a thrusting arm and hooks the rib behind the elbow to pin it.

name: Granite Rustle
description: Cuts the wrist then the elbow then the shoulder in three quick strokes while stepping inside the reach.

name: Fanoutbarrage
description: Gathers qi in the ribs for a breath then sweeps the fan flat to throw a cutting crescent across every foe ahead.

name: Glint Spreadface
description: Beats the iron rib against a sword's weak point with focused qi until the blade splits at the guard.

name: Reverie Fanrib
description: Spreads the fan at brow height for a heartbeat so the opponent loses track of the real hand.

name: Might Silkface
description: Slams the closed ribs down on the opponent's raised guard to jar the hands.

name: Torrent Rivetpin
description: Swivels on the heel while the fan arm swings round to follow and keep the guard line closed.

name: Rustleassault
description: Jabs the folded tip into the side of the knee to buckle the standing leg.

name: Gustfantip
description: Slaps the pleated edge into the oncoming palm and turns the strike off its path.

name: Equipoise Rimrib
description: Spreads the fan across a cut to turn it aside and answers with the outer rib at the throat.

name: Ponderous Fantip
description: Pins the opponent's elbow against their ribs with the folded bundle and strikes the exposed side.

name: Might Waft
description: Advances in shifting steps behind a slowly turning open leaf so the true distance is hard to judge.

name: Thorn Spreadface
description: Fills the opened leaf with a steady flow of qi so it turns a rain of blows and thrown blades.

name: Rumblerustle
description: Spins the opened fan off the wrist so it arcs to a distant foe and a thread of qi draws it home.

name: Mayhem Flutter
description: Tosses the shut fan a hand's breadth into the air and catches it to draw the opponent's eyes upward.

name: Unmaking Snapshut
description: Catches the fan on the downswing and turns the same motion into a cut across the opponent's guard hand.

name: Blurring Fanout
description: Steps off with the fan hand leading so the throw begins with the body already moving.

name: Rimribcloak
description: Turns the open fan backhand to meet a cut on the leaf edge and roll it away.

name: Hardened Silkface
description: Catches the spinning fan from a short toss and uses its last turn to sweep a blade aside.

name: Hamstringing Wavering
description: Snags a sleeve or sword guard with a rib tip and steps back to pull the opponent off balance.

name: Sanguine Pivotpin
description: Beats the wrist twice with the ribs then hooks the closed fan behind it and drags the arm down.

name: Facetwaft
description: Hurls the opened fan edge-first on a flat spin so it skims the gap and cuts a distant opponent.

name: Splintering Flutter
description: Pulls the thrown fan home on a thread of qi so it cuts a second time on its return path.

name: Rimribcuirass
description: Braces the steel-faced fan against the shoulder and forearm and takes a heavy swing on the plates.

name: Might Foldedge
description: Lifts the shut steel fan overhead and smashes it down on the opponent's helm or shoulder guard.

name: Racing Waft
description: Turns the armored shoulder into the line of a charge and slides past it behind the fan.

name: Sanguine Fantip
description: Scrapes the rivet and outer rib across the back of the opponent's gauntlet until the grip loosens.

name: Might Rustle
description: Thrusts the closed steel fan straight at the gap under the breastplate with both hands.

name: Murk Fanspine
description: Tilts the polished steel leaf into the sun so a bar of glare crosses the opponent's visor.

name: Fantipplating
description: Presses forward behind the opened steel leaf and shoulders the opponent's weapon arm out of line.

name: Gyverimrib
description: Wedges a blade between two iron ribs and twists the fan until the weapon cannot be drawn back.

name: Drubbing Guardrib
description: Hammers the ribs on one guard point again and again until the defending arm drops.

name: Iron Rivetpin
description: Drives the steel-tipped outer rib into the join of armor plates with qi packed into its point.

name: Facet Guardrib
description: Spins the armored fan in a steady wide circle so its rim turns arrows and blows while the user advances.

name: Granite Pivotpin
description: Crosses both fans before the chest in the paired guard of the court school.

name: Raging Wavering
description: Strikes with the right fan then the left in a matched pair of short cuts to the forearms.

name: Gust Fanspine
description: Meets a cut between the two fans and sends it wide with an outward flick of both wrists.

name: Granite Snapshut
description: Steps forward in a measured court pace with both fans held low and level at the hips.

name: Reverie Rimrib
description: Throws the left fan open across the eyes as a veil while the right fan prepares the real cut.

name: Rumble Rivetpin
description: Slashes both wrists of the opponent at once with the two outer ribs from either side.

name: Subduing Fanout
description: Closes both open fans on an arm like shears and holds it fast between the ribs.

name: Blazewaft
description: Spreads both fans wide in a stoop like a hawk's wings and cuts across the target as the body passes.

name: Thornfantip
description: Steps down a short slope of the stance with the fans raised so a descending blow is caught and spent.

name: Rumblefanout
description: Beats the guard with the two fans in alternating strokes so the opponent cannot find an opening to answer.

name: Downpour Pivotpin
description: Draws qi into both fans for a breath then sweeps them out together to throw crossed crescents of cutting force.

name: Splitting Snapshut
description: Drives both shut fans forward in a crossing thrust that punches through a guard held across the chest.

name: Fanribhauberk
description: Folds both fans against the forearms like a hawk drawing in its wings and meets the blow on them.

name: Rumble Fanrib
description: Rakes the sharpened rib tips down the opponent's face and chest like talons.

name: Gust Spreadface
description: Curves forward in a long bend like a river around a rock and ends beside the opponent's shoulder.

name: Blaze Rimrib
description: Darts both shut tips at the opponent's eyes together and forces a flinch.

name: Foldedge Barrage
description: Drops from a high guard into a cut and withdraws on the rebound before the answer lands.

name: Paralyzing Waft
description: Turns one fan under a thrusting arm to deflect it and closes the second fan over the wrist.

name: Equipoise Fanrib
description: Glides sideways with the fans crossed to carry a cut past the shoulder and end beside the attacker.

name: Scything Nova Flutter
description: Hurls one open fan in a falling arc like a stooping hawk while the other hand guards the body.

name: Staunch Guardrib
description: Spreads both fans wide as a pair of wings and walks forward beneath them against volleys of thrown blades.

name: Guardrib Cloak
description: Settles into a low wide stance like a riverbed with the fan flat before the belly and the weight sunk.

name: Fantipthrash
description: Cuts along the rim of the opponent's guard with the outer rib and drags it toward the elbow.

name: Siltrustle
description: Follows the push of the opponent's own advance and slides along it to the open side.

name: Sanguine Rustle
description: Runs two ribs along the outside of the opponent's arm in a double scrape from wrist to shoulder.

name: Enduring Spreadface
description: Bends the open fan away from a hard cut like a reed in a current and lets the blade slip past.

name: Harpooning Fantip
description: Sweeps the edge round the opponent's guard and slips out along the bend before the counter starts.

name: Thorn Wavering
description: Lets a strike pool against the opened leaf and then closes the ribs on the weapon arm.

name: Gustrimrib
description: Crosses the opponent's line in a single wading step and cuts the open edge back across the ribs.

name: Dismantling Rustle
description: Gathers qi like meltwater behind the fan then heaves it forward in a sweeping surge that breaks over every foe ahead.

name: Wrecking Wavering
description: Beats the open fan in a steady circling rhythm so pressure builds on the opponent's guard and pins it low.

name: Unshaken Fanspine
description: Holds one fan high and one low in the dual-track guard so both lines of attack are covered.

name: Gust Foldedge
description: Jabs the left fan's shut tip along the near track into the opponent's lead shoulder.

name: Drubbing Rivetpin
description: Cuts the right fan's outer rib along the far track across the opponent's trailing hand.

name: Flutter Pounce
description: Changes from one line of attack to the other in a single crossing step.

name: Fanribcloak
description: Turns a blade aside on the left fan while the right fan cuts the exposed forearm.

name: Fastening Waft
description: Closes both fans on the opponent's arm and steps along the second track to pull them off balance.

name: Pivotpin Torment
description: Thrusts one fan at the guard and sends the second down the same line a heartbeat later to drive through the gap.

name: Siltfantip
description: Draws qi into the fans along two tracks then releases twin crescents that sweep the field before the body.

name: Ironfanrib
description: Plants the feet on bare ground with no cover and holds the open fan at an angle to the wind line.

name: Unmaking Silkface
description: Cuts the outer rib straight down the line the wind is blowing so the stroke lands fast.

name: Glancing Snapshut
description: Steps along the very edge of the footing with the fan trailing to hold the balance.

name: Splintering Silkface
description: Jabs the shut tip along a bearing taken in advance so the thrust arrives exactly where aimed.

name: Torrent Rimrib
description: Sets the free palm on the back of the fan and meets a cut with a firm outward turn.

name: Glamour Fantip
description: Flicks the fan in a quick gust at the eyes to draw a flinch from the opponent.

name: Fantipbarrage
description: Slashes the edge across the flank and slips downwind of the opponent's answering cut.

name: Rimribplating
description: Holds the chosen bearing while the leaf turns a blade aside and the rib returns along the same line.

name: Quelling Silkface
description: Hooks an arm with the open ribs and drags it downwind as the user steps clear.

name: Dismantling Foldedge
description: Swings the open fan low to high in one pull and a sheet of cutting wind runs ahead across every foe.

name: Annealed Fanrib
description: Fans a steady current before the body so arrows and thrown knives are carried off line on open ground.

name: Thornrimrib
description: Stands at the rim with the fan angled outward so a blow from the front glances over the edge.

name: Tempered Waft
description: Jabs the folded tip at the exact spot the opponent's bearing ends and the guard thins.

name: Rumblefantip
description: Brushes the open leaf edge across the cheek and throat in a single light wiping cut.

name: Bounding Flutter
description: Slides across the line of a charge with the fan held high like a sail.

name: Rimribhauberk
description: Lifts the wrist in a rising flick to carry a downward cut up and over the shoulder.

name: Remnant Rimrib
description: Waves the fan low over loose ground to raise dust into the opponent's face.

name: Fanout Assault
description: Draws the fan from the sash in a step and cuts across before the opponent has set a guard.

name: Torrent Fanspine
description: Takes a fresh bearing against a thrust and turns it aside then cuts back along the new line.

name: Fanout Cuirass
description: Hooks a weapon arm along the wind line and pulls it out of true as the body steps round.

name: Snapshut Assault
description: Runs along the opponent's guard with a long sweeping slash that tears it away from its center.

name: Silt Pivotpin
description: Gathers qi like a gale rising across the plateau and releases it in one great sweep of the fan.

name: Rimribassault
description: Thrusts the rib tip along the chosen bearing with qi gathered at its point to pass through a held guard.

name: Guardrib Plating
description: Fixes the feet on a chosen bearing and holds the fan steady across the body.

name: Cleaving Fanout
description: Flicks the fan back over the shoulder to strike a pursuer behind with the rear rib.

name: Torrent Fanrib
description: Slides to the windward side so the fan's gust and the sun are both at the user's back.

name: Chime Spreadface
description: Turns the open leaf away from a thrust so the point passes harmlessly along it.

name: Might Guardrib
description: Cuts the open edge across the opponent's guard then steps windward to leave the line of their answer.

name: Ponderous Wavering
description: Folds the fan on the sheltered side of a thrust and catches the arm between the ribs.

name: Scything Rivetpin
description: Beats the ribs against a rising sword hand in a firm rhythm until the weapon dips.

name: Hoarfrost Fanspine
description: Hurls the open fan across the wind so it curves in from the side and cuts the target.

name: Shadefanout
description: Fans steadily against the opponent's advance and holds them to the bearing the user has taken.

name: Thornfanrib
description: Plants the fan before the body in the oath stance and meets the first blow without stepping back.

name: Tempered Pivotpin
description: Whips the outer rib across the opponent's wrist in a cut as fast as a sudden gust.

name: Blurring Wavering
description: Sidesteps in the direction the wind blows with the open fan carried high to catch it.

name: Gust Rivetpin
description: Brushes a punch aside with the bare palm while the fan guards the opposite line.

name: Iron Rustle
description: Snaps the weighted tassel across the opponent's eyes or knuckles by a flick of the wrist.

name: Staggering Flutter
description: Locks an arm between the ribs in the oath hold and shields the body behind the leaf.

name: Rupturing Fantip
description: Chains cut after cut along one unwavering bearing while advancing a step with each stroke.

name: Resilient Rimrib
description: Rides the push of a heavy cut with the open leaf and returns a cutting stroke at its end.

name: Daybreak Rustle
description: Draws a long breath of qi into the fan and sweeps it round so a roaring gale cuts across the field.

name: Needling Gust Silkface
description: Hurls the shut fan skyward and lets it fall edge-first onto a foe at range under no cover.
